info.name: SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) SAP BRIM Subscription Billing API

description.content:
API for managing subscription lifecycle within the SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) suite. Supports creation, modification, renewal, suspension, and cancellation of subscriptions across various billing frequencies and subscription models including recurring, usage-based, and hybrid subscriptions.
